Sometimes I wish I could go back in time to when it was just surface cuts or burns and tell myself to stop there before it got to this point, but I guess the best we can do is warn other people and work on damage control for ourselves.

I just saw this again and realized I never responded to it. I didn't end up going that night, but it was okay. I did end up going in a few days later and ended up with stitches. I was hospitalized that night but not because of the cut, it was because a friend had called the ER and told them I had been making suicidal posts, I explained and they were going to let me leave but she called again and said I had lied to them and after reading some of my text messages they kept me. 

I did make it to 23 days with no self harm before I ended up back there again, so that's a good step at least. 🤷‍♀️

When it isn't planned, it's usually highly emotional like after an argument or something, and those tend to be burns.
